subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should OpenClaw add a core status-card visibility control for `/status` and `session_status`, and should it hide the whole card or only sensitive sections such as usage/cost/provider quota?
rationale: The source proof shows the request is still missing, but adding the fix creates a new config/security surface and the exact semantics are a product decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add section visibility
options.body: Add a default-preserving config contract that can suppress sensitive sections such as usage/cost while keeping non-sensitive status lines visible.

options.title: Add whole-card mode
options.body: Add a boolean or format mode that hides the rendered card and returns only structured/tool details where applicable.

options.title: Reject new config
options.body: Keep current status-card behavior and close this tracker if maintainers decide the extra config surface is not worth carrying.

recommendation.title: Add section visibility
recommendation.body: Add a default-preserving config contract that can suppress sensitive sections such as usage/cost while keeping non-sensitive status lines visible.
